features.name: Dream over opted-in session checkpoints
features.user_goal: Reflect on selected Margo session evidence, review candidate interpretations and retrieve relevant sourced episodes next session
prerequisites: Explicit account, memory and task initialization
Reviewed exact account/host/workspace capture policy including episode and decision kinds
Authorized current-session checkpoint adapter
features.approval: Capture requires exact policy opt-in; interpretations remain candidates and human confirmation is separate from output review
limitations: Only selected current-session checkpoints; session listing is not content access
Manual bounded pages; individually oversized checkpoints are reported and excluded without blocking later events
Overlapping runs reuse exact-revision eligible episodes without reviving suppressed or forgotten outputs
No schedule or history importer is shipped
Synthetic runtime evidence does not evaluate model reasoning or entailment

features.name: Get a first useful brief
features.user_goal: Install Margo and confirm the Work IQ connection works
prerequisites: GitHub Copilot CLI
Python 3.9+
features.approval: Installation and account configuration are not authentication; no external action is taken
limitations: Account configuration does not itself sign in to Work IQ

features.name: Know which account and where data lives
features.user_goal: Confirm the private, account-scoped storage location before any data is captured
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Configuring storage performs no reads or writes to Microsoft 365
limitations: Local SQLite storage is not application-encrypted

features.name: Make Margo work the way you do
features.user_goal: Teach preferences, VIPs, working hours and drafting voice so recommendations and drafts match how you actually work
prerequisites: setup complete
features.approval: Preferences shape recommendations and drafts; they never authorize a send by themselves
limitations: An unfilled preferences file falls back to generic defaults, not a personalized voice

features.name: Update without losing your settings or work
features.user_goal: Upgrade an existing installation while preserving preferences, commitments and durable state
prerequisites: An existing installation
features.approval: Upgrading copies files only; it never sends, schedules, or changes external state
limitations: Copy updates require remote revision and VERSION access; offline updates fail without changing the installation
A --link install has nothing to copy; update the reviewed clone explicitly instead
File installation does not migrate private state, synchronize saved app workflow prompts or reload running sessions/extensions

features.name: Remove Margo without losing personal files
features.user_goal: Uninstall managed files while keeping personal preferences and the private runtime database recoverable
features.approval: Uninstall never deletes the account's private runtime directory
limitations: Personal files are backed up, not deleted, and must be removed manually if truly unwanted

features.name: Run Margo unattended somewhere other than a laptop
features.user_goal: Run scheduled routines in a container instead of a local machine, with the same unattended contract
prerequisites: A container runtime
A one-time interactive Work IQ sign-in to seed the OAuth volume
features.approval: A container never gains a permission a local unattended run does not already have
limitations: Verified on the documented Linux container setup; not a claim of universal host support
A sleeping host still cannot run a scheduled job

features.name: Know what needs attention today
features.user_goal: Get a bounded, cited brief of today's calendar, mail and Teams, with priorities and suggested next steps
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: External actions from a brief (send, schedule, RSVP) require their own separate approval
limitations: A source that fails to load is a visible gap, never a false all-clear

features.name: See what changed since you were away
features.user_goal: Catch up on mail, meetings and Teams changes since a chosen point without re-reading everything
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Read-only synthesis; any resulting reply or change needs its own approval
limitations: Delta coverage is per source; one source's freshness does not establish another's

features.name: Close the day without dropping anything
features.user_goal: Wrap up the day: what got resolved, what rolls to tomorrow, and what you committed to today
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Candidates staged from an EOD run still require explicit confirmation to become obligations
limitations: An unattended EOD run leaves candidates staged; it never confirms them

features.name: Prepare for what next week actually needs
features.user_goal: See the shape of next week: load, prep debt, focus time, conflicts and what's due, while there's still time to act
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Proposed fixes (declines, agendas, focus blocks) are drafts awaiting their own approval
limitations: Missing deadlines, estimates or calendar coverage stay explicit gaps, never invented

features.name: Clear your inbox with confidence
features.user_goal: Turn a noisy inbox into a short, ranked, decision-ready list with a recommended action per item
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Mark-read/archive may be a bounded standing grant; reply, forward and delete stay per-action
limitations: A bulk action is re-confirmed with its exact count before it runs

features.name: Find what needs a reply in Teams
features.user_goal: Build an attention queue across chats and channels since there is no native unread feed to rely on
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Teams replies and reactions always require per-action approval, with no standing exception
limitations: Recency is reported as recency; Work IQ exposes no native Teams unread/notification feed

features.name: Get a ready-to-send draft in your voice
features.user_goal: Produce a grounded reply, new message or Teams draft written in your voice, never the assistant's
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Nothing sends until you say so for that specific draft; edits invalidate a prior approval
limitations: A timeout or uncertain send result is reconciled, never silently retried

features.name: Land a high-stakes message with the right tone
features.user_goal: Turn a meeting or thread into an executive-ready follow-up: listen-first, specific, credited by name
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: The exact destination chat and text are both approved together, never the topic alone
limitations: Ambiguous destination chats stop for a human choice rather than guessing

features.name: Find time without the back-and-forth
features.user_goal: Find and propose meeting times that respect working hours and protected focus blocks
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: The event is created only after you approve the exact proposed time and attendees
limitations: Availability for people outside your visibility is stated as an assumption, not fact

features.name: Move a meeting without making a mess
features.user_goal: Reschedule or cancel a specific occurrence, showing who is affected before anything changes
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Cancelling or moving a meeting sends a notification and needs the same care as any send
limitations: Only the organizer can move or cancel the event outright; others get a proposal

features.name: Triage invitations quickly
features.user_goal: Classify pending invitations against your standing rules and calendar conflicts, with a recommended response for each
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Accept/decline/tentative always needs per-action approval, batched or not
limitations: A batch response is re-confirmed with the exact set before it sends

features.name: See what your calendar actually costs you
features.user_goal: Quantify optional hours, fragmentation and agenda-less meetings, and name the specific ones worth cutting
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Declining or dropping a recurring series is always per-action, with no standing exception
limitations: A truncated calendar pull understates the problem; the window must be fully paged

features.name: Walk into a meeting ready
features.user_goal: Assemble purpose, people, context and talking points for an upcoming meeting, including linked agenda topics and unresolved work
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Any offered follow-on (pre-read, agenda, message) is a separate draft awaiting approval
limitations: A missing attachment is reported, not silently omitted from the prep card

features.name: Close the loop after a meeting
features.user_goal: Turn a recap or transcript into your actions, what you're waiting on, and unresolved gaps nobody owns
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Proposed work-ledger changes and drafts stay proposals until you confirm or approve them
limitations: No recap available means pending/unknown, never zero decisions or actions

features.name: Never rebuild a recurring meeting from scratch
features.user_goal: Keep one durable record per meeting occurrence: preparation, delayed-recap retries, debrief and carry-forward
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Carrying work forward reuses existing IDs; it never re-ingests or silently closes an item
limitations: Calendar presence is not proof of attendance unless the source establishes it

features.name: Never reconstruct a 1:1 agenda five minutes before it
features.user_goal: Keep a rolling, editable agenda per person, accumulated through the week and rendered before the meeting
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Turning an agenda topic into a tracked obligation still needs its own confirmation
limitations: Two attendees alone is not enough signal; a recurring, titled meeting is required

features.name: Notice who you've quietly stopped talking to
features.user_goal: Surface drifting relationships against an intended cadence, ambient-only and capped at a handful a week
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: This never drafts or sends anything itself; scheduling or messaging is a separate step
limitations: No contact on record is not proof no contact happened outside a tracked surface

features.name: Know what to read before it's too late
features.user_goal: Surface shared documents worth reading, tied to a person, meeting, deadline or commitment, and age out the rest
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: This only recommends read/defer/decline; nothing is shared or replied to on its own
limitations: A labelled sensitive document is cited, never excerpted into a forwardable card

features.name: Pull a large file from Microsoft 365 to disk
features.user_goal: Download a file over the 4 MB MCP transport limit straight to local disk without flooding the conversation
prerequisites: A one-time browser sign-in (macOS Keychain today)
features.approval: Downloading is a read; nothing is shared or modified in Microsoft 365
limitations: Verified working on macOS; the refresh-token store is macOS Keychain today, not a cross-platform claim
RMS-protected files are refused, not silently corrupted

features.name: Copy a file server-side within Microsoft 365
features.user_goal: Copy a large file between Microsoft 365 locations without pulling bytes to this machine
prerequisites: A Graph app registration with Files.ReadWrite.All or Sites.ReadWrite.All
features.approval: Blocked today: the consented app registration has no write scope, so the command cannot run
limitations: Blocked on a missing write scope in the consented app, not a code defect
Do not route this through the Work IQ MCP action; it returns a permission denial there too

features.name: Upload a local file into Microsoft 365
features.user_goal: Upload a local file to a Microsoft 365 location once write scope is granted
prerequisites: A Graph app registration with Files.ReadWrite.All or Sites.ReadWrite.All
features.approval: Blocked today: the consented app registration has no write scope, so the command cannot run
limitations: Blocked on a missing write scope in the consented app, not a code defect
The >250MB upload-session path also needs a SharePoint-audience token this app cannot obtain

features.name: Share a file without emailing the bytes
features.user_goal: Grant a specific person read access to a file, without sending an email notification unless you ask for one
prerequisites: Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Sharing is visible to the recipient and always needs its own explicit per-action approval
limitations: Uses the standard approved Work IQ write path, separate from the blocked local-bridge copy/upload commands

features.name: Track an ask without inventing a promise
features.user_goal: Capture a request as sourced evidence, then confirm it as an obligation only after you say so
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Confirming an obligation is not permission to send anything related to it
limitations: Different source/claim identities can create separate candidates; near-duplicates need human review

features.name: Know what you're waiting on, before it's overdue
features.user_goal: Age every open row, check for silent resolution first, and prepare the right nudge at the right rung
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
Configured Work IQ MCP connection
features.approval: Each drafted nudge is confirmed individually; a batch approval does not cover several people
limitations: A row is promoted only the run it crosses a threshold, not every day after

features.name: See what's ready for your decision
features.user_goal: Review, edit, defer or dismiss a prepared action proposal before anything is sent
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Dismissing a proposal only hides it; it does not close the underlying work item
limitations: The canvas can edit and defer/dismiss a proposal; it has no approve/send endpoint

features.name: Approve once, safely
features.user_goal: Approve an exact action, get a fresh preflight check immediately before it runs, and get an honest result even when the outcome is unclear
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Approval is bound to the exact target, payload, revision and hash; any change invalidates it
limitations: An uncertain outcome is reconciled from real evidence; it is never retried blindly

features.name: Review proposals without a second CLI window
features.user_goal: Inspect and edit durable Margo proposals in an optional app panel instead of the CLI
prerequisites: The optional canvas extension enabled with --action-desk / -ActionDesk
features.approval: The canvas has no approve/send endpoint; a review request is not consent
limitations: Candidate work records and typed records are read-only in the canvas

features.name: Agree what success looks like this week
features.user_goal: Agree up to three weekly outcomes with an owner, definition of done, due date and effort estimate
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Agreeing an outcome never approves a calendar change or a message on its own
limitations: At most three outcomes may be agreed/active/achieved at once; a longer list must be discussed

features.name: Check whether a plan actually fits the week
features.user_goal: Calculate real available time from working hours, meetings, leave and protected blocks, with honest gaps for missing data
features.approval: Capacity output never triggers a calendar change; that stays in the action desk
limitations: Incomplete coverage or a missing estimate makes fit unknown, not false

features.name: Correct Margo without a permanent rule you didn't ask for
features.user_goal: Record a specific correction tied to the exact item it applies to, without turning it into a standing rule
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Recording a correction never grants action permission or activates a rule; future behavior changes require a separately confirmed scoped rule
limitations: Silence, delay or a dismissed proposal is never treated as a preference

features.name: Turn a repeated correction into a standing rule
features.user_goal: Propose a scoped rule from supporting examples, then activate it only with explicit confirmation
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Activation requires an explicit yes; a rule can never grant send permission or lower approval
limitations: Revoking a rule does not erase its evidence or change messages already sent

features.name: Say 'not a lesson' and mean it
features.user_goal: Mark an interaction as explicitly not to be learned from, without an operational receipt claiming otherwise
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: This is a minimal opt-out marker, not a request that changes any external state
limitations: This is not a general erasure facility for prior records; see memory-control for that

features.name: Get a useful first draft of the real deliverable
features.user_goal: Produce a decision memo, comparison, status update, agenda or delegation brief tied to its sources
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Content approval is separate from delivery approval; nothing is shared automatically
limitations: Unattended preparation is local only and bounded to the single highest-priority item

features.name: Know a work product actually reached someone
features.user_goal: Link a prepared artifact to its real delivery receipt once it has actually been shared
prerequisites: Explicit account configured via margo_store.py init
features.approval: Recording a receipt never performs the send/share itself; that is a separate approved action
limitations: Content approval for a memo is not approval to publish or send it

features.name: Never miss a stale review request
features.user_goal: See review requests, your own stale PRs and assigned issues across both GitHub accounts, aged and cited
prerequisites: `gh` CLI signed in
Repositories listed in preferences.md
features.approval: Reviewing, commenting, merging, closing or labelling always needs its own explicit approval
limitations: A failed or empty search is unknown, not zero, until both accounts are queried successfully

features.name: Review your Azure DevOps backlog without hunting for the query
features.user_goal: Run the saved bug and backlog queries by ID and summarize priority, staleness and ownership
prerequisites: Azure CLI with the azure-devops extension
Configured org/project/queries
features.approval: Creating or updating a work item always needs the exact field change approved first
limitations: A tree query returns empty from `az boards query --id`; the REST route is required, not an empty backlog

features.name: See what your Viva Engage community actually thinks
features.user_goal: Surface unanswered questions and recurring themes from a product's Viva Engage community
prerequisites: Community name and GroupId recorded in preferences.md
features.approval: Posting an Engage reply is public and always needs explicit approval, written in your voice
limitations: The verified Work IQ binding exposed grounded retrieval, not structured Engage paths or usable reply/upvote counts; re-check current host capabilities
The bundled parser has no dedicated automated test in this repository

features.name: See what's breaking, from the people hitting it
features.user_goal: Surface unanswered reports and recurring failure themes from a product's Teams feedback channel
prerequisites: Team ID and Channel ID recorded in preferences.md
features.approval: Posting a reply always needs explicit approval, written in your voice with no sign-off
limitations: A partial page sweep is reported as partial, never as a clean unanswered count
The bundled parser has no dedicated automated test in this repository

features.name: Log what a team actually decided
features.user_goal: Extract genuine decisions from a meeting or thread, separating them from discussion, tasks and open questions
prerequisites: The decision-log skill installed (--all)
config.md filled in
features.approval: Nothing is written to the log until the proposed records are explicitly approved
limitations: Under-extraction is the deliberate failure mode; unsure items are marked needs-confirmation

features.name: Get the current answer, not a stale one
features.user_goal: Ask why something was decided and get the current record, with the supersession chain if it changed
prerequisites: The decision-log skill installed (--all)
features.approval: Read-only; answering a question never writes to the log

features.name: Change your mind on the record

prerequisites: The decision-log skill installed (--all)
features.approval: A supersession is written only after explicit approval, same as any other log write
limitations: Records are immutable; only Status changes, so history is never edited away

features.name: Get a short weekly read of what changed

prerequisites: The decision-log skill installed (--all)
features.approval: The digest is read-only output; it never writes a record on its own
limitations: An unowned open question is flagged, not silently dropped from the digest

features.name: Find what's unresolved in the log

prerequisites: The decision-log skill installed (--all)
features.approval: Audit only proposes fixes; it never changes a record without explicit approval
limitations: A one-way decision with no recorded rationale is flagged, not rewritten

features.name: Get the morning brief without asking for it

features.name: Get an end-of-day wrap-up automatically

features.name: Get next week's shape before Monday

features.approval: Unattended runs never send, post, RSVP or change a work item under any standing grant

features.name: Get a weekly commitments and ambient digest

features.approval: Unattended runs never send, post, RSVP or change a work item under any standing grant

features.name: Get cheap, silent hourly checks

features.approval: Unattended runs never send, post, RSVP or change a work item under any standing grant

The schedule itself lives only in automations/*.md front matter

features.name: Get a quiet daily scan for slow-moving drift

features.name: Trust that a brief actually covered its sources

features.name: Get one honest health report

features.name: Let Margo remember useful context, on your terms

Explicit memory_state.py init

features.name: Recall relevant context by meaning, not just keywords
